text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
I will display it with great care!
choice_data_list: If you display all of them, won't they take up too much space?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, no, compared to the oversized
plushie I brought from home,
this is downright cute.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If anything, around this size
might be easier to hug while sleeping...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, it's a plushie you won for me.
I will treasure it forever!
